domains.name: Talent misallocation and job market issues

notes: P1, P2, and P3 are linked through the theme of talent misallocation and job market inefficiencies. P4, P5, and P6 co-revise as they all relate to the measurement of soft skills and cognitive assessments. P8 and P10 are connected through the identification of traits that distinguish top performers. P9 stands alone as it focuses on the measurement of skills through the game. P11 is a distinct revenue model.
